title: A Visit to the Museum
description: Four recordings about a museum visit: a family plan, a ticket desk, a message and a guide's talk.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Deciding what to see
parts.intro: You will hear a girl, Hoa, and her dad deciding about a museum visit.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Dad, can we go to the history museum on Sunday?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Good idea, Hoa. But I thought you wanted to go swimming.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: I did, but the pool is closed for repairs until next month.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: I see. What would you like to see at the museum?

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: The dinosaur bones, of course! My friend Mai says there's a skeleton that's as long as a bus.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Wonderful. And I'd like to see the old coins. Shall we invite Grandma too?

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: She can't walk very far, so let's ask her to meet us in the café at lunchtime.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: OK. I'll drive. We'll leave at ten o'clock and be there by eleven.

parts.title: Part 2 · At the ticket desk
parts.intro: You will hear a man buying tickets at the museum.

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: Good morning. Can I help you?

script.speaker: Visitor
script.text: Yes, please. I'd like tickets for two adults and three children.

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: Adult tickets are six pounds, and children's tickets are free on Sundays.

script.speaker: Visitor
script.text: Excellent! Is the dinosaur room open today?

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: It's open, but the Egyptian room is closed. We're cleaning the mummies.

script.speaker: Visitor
script.text: Oh, what a pity. My son loves ancient Egypt.

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: There's a children's workshop at two o'clock. They can make a paper pyramid.

script.speaker: Visitor
script.text: That sounds great. Where is it?

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: On the second floor, next to the lift. And you can leave your bags in the cloakroom for free.

parts.title: Part 3 · A voicemail
parts.intro: You will hear a message from a teacher, Mr Long, about a class visit.

script.speaker: Mr Long
script.text: Hello, parents of Class Five. This is Mr Long with news about our museum visit next Wednesday.

script.speaker: Mr Long
script.text: The coach will leave from the school at nine o'clock, not eight o'clock as I said before. We will return at half past three.

script.speaker: Mr Long
script.text: The children need a notebook and a pencil, because they must write about three things they see. Please do not send pens, as they are not allowed near the paintings.

script.speaker: Mr Long
script.text: Lunch will be at the museum. The children can bring a packed lunch, or order a hot meal for four pounds. Please tell me by Monday.

script.speaker: Mr Long
script.text: Finally, please sign the form and send it back tomorrow. Thank you very much.

parts.title: Part 4 · A guide's talk
parts.intro: You will hear a museum guide, Nam, talking to visitors.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hello, everybody. I'm Nam, and I'll show you the oldest part of our museum.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: This was once a castle, and the walls are nine hundred years old. Please don't touch them, because they are fragile.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: In this room, you can see a king's crown and some swords. The crown is made of gold, but the swords are made of iron.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: The most surprising thing here is the tiny boat. It's only one metre long, but it carried six people across the river.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Next, we'll go downstairs to see the old kitchen. It smells wonderful because a cook is baking bread, and you can try some.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: You can take photos, but please turn off the flash. Now follow me, and mind the steps.
